ruleDefinitions.name: Microsoft Office DLL Sideload
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects DLL sideloading of DLLs that are part of Microsoft Office from non standard location Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\outllib\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\OFFICE") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\OFFICE") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\Root\\\\OFFICE") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\Root\\\\OFFICE")))
